name: Normal Trade Relations
source:
The story starts on your birthday and you quickly find passages in your wife's diary that makes it clear to you that not everything has been as she has claimed. Above that, her ex-fiancée has made his way back in her life, this time dating her best friend.

[From [url=https://lostworks.itch.io/normal-trade-relations]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事从你的生日开始，你很快就在你妻子的日记中找到了一些段落，这些段落让你清楚地知道一切并不像她声称的那样。除此之外，她的前未婚妻又回到了她的生活，这次和她最好的朋友约会。

[来自[url=https://lostworks.itch.io/normal-trade-relations]Itch.io[/url]]
